text.en:
Section 27 of Republic Act No. 7166 is hereby amended to read as follows:
"
Separability Clause. - If any part of this Act is held invalid or unconstitutional, the remaining parts or provisions hereof shall remain valid and effective.
Repealing Clause. - All laws, decrees, executive orders, rules and regulations, or parts thereof, inconsistent with the provisions of this Act are hereby repealed.
Effectivity. - This Act shall take effect immediately upon its approval.
